name: Francesco Moraca
bioAdditions: Francesco Maria was baptized on 22 July 1793, son of Angelo Moraca and Rosanna Marasco (S1). He married Francesca Orlando on 16 March 1819 (S2) and died on 23 February 1837, aged about 43 (recorded as 40) (S3).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Baptism, marriage and death all indexed and consistent; daughter Rosa's records name him.
